description: This week I had a great time at Sportsman's Day at the State Capitol, wild game cookout, great people, and a real conversation about what matters to hunters, anglers, and families across this state. I was there because this fight is personal. Colorado’s sportsmen aren’t weekend hobbyists; you’re the ones actually keeping wildlife healthy and on the landscape. The licenses and tags you buy keep Colorado Parks and Wildlife running. Take you out of the picture, and the conservation system collapses
title: TEAM VICTOR WEEKLY TEAM UPDATE April 27, 2026
